{{Short description|none}}
The [[Copa Sudamericana]] is an annual [[association football|football]] cup competition organized by [[CONMEBOL]] since 2002 for football club in [[South American]].

[[Miller Bolaños]] is the only player to have finished as the Copa Sudamericana top scorer multiple times, having done so in [[2014 Copa Sudamericana|2014]] and [[2015 Copa Sudamericana|2015]]. Argentine players have been the top scorer ten times, the most of any country. Cameroonian [[Pierre Webó]] is the only non-South American to have finished as top scorer, doing so in [[2002 Copa Sudamericana|2002]]. The most goals in a single edition was achieved by [[Eduardo Vargas]], who scored eleven goals in [[2011 Copa Sudamericana|2011]].
